mods.name: Archipelago
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: The Archipelago multiworld client for the Ys Origin apworld, written in Lua on CleriaCore's mod API: the AP protocol, checks sent on chest open, vanilla items swallowed with a relabelled treasure box, items granted (saved with the game, never twice), DeathLink, the goal, an item feed, a tracker and its settings under Mods > Archipelago.

mods.name: Achievements
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: Thirty achievements for Ys Origin, kept across all your saves: bosses, hitless fights, close calls, combos, a deathless clear, a clear with each character. A card when one is earned, the list and your progress on its page.

mods.name: Adaptive Difficulty
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: Enemies hit a little softer each time you die, and return to normal as you clear rooms and bosses without dying. Optionally they hit harder than normal while you are on a streak.

mods.name: Autosave+
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: Rolling autosaves in slots of their own: every few minutes of play, after each boss, and in each new zone. The oldest autosave is replaced, your own saves are never touched.

mods.name: Bestiary+
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: A hunting log kept with each save: every kind of monster you have killed, how many, the EXP and SP they gave and where you first met them. A card announces each new kind.

mods.name: Co-op
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: Play Ys Origin with friends: one hosts, the others join. You see each other, a room's monsters are the same for everybody and chase all of you, boss gauges fall together, EXP and SP are shared, and a teammate nearby gets you back up.

mods.name: Crowd Control
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: Your Twitch chat votes on what happens to you: every minute three effects are put to a vote (type 1, 2 or 3 in chat) and the winner is applied. Reads chat anonymously: no account, no token.

mods.name: Daily Challenge
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: One challenge a day, the same for everyone: today's date shuffles the tower's chests and picks two rules. Finish the game and get a result code to compare with friends.

mods.name: Debug Menu
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: A page to change anything about your game: level, SP, HP, weapon, every item, armor and leggings with their upgrades, the three skills and their levels, blessings, statue warps and raw game flags. For testing and for fun.

mods.name: Level Sync
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: Monsters fight as if they were near your level, so the whole tower stays relevant: weak ones are lifted, strong ones are tamed, and their EXP follows. Bosses are not changed.

mods.name: LiveSplit Autosplitter
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: Drives LiveSplit over its WebSocket server: starts the timer on a new game, splits on bosses (and optionally on each new zone), and can send the game time without cutscenes.

mods.name: Mutators
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: Challenge rules you switch on from F1 > Mods > Mutators: Glass Cannon, Berserker, One Hit, a level cap, Vampire, Midas, Famine and Permadeath. Mix them freely.

mods.name: New Game+
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: Finish the game, then start again stronger: a new game keeps part of your level, your SP and your weapon, and the tower hits back harder with each cycle.

mods.name: Roguelite Perks
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: Every boss you beat lets you choose one of three random perks, kept with the save: more ATK, DEF or HP, healing on kills, better drops, more SP or EXP, longer buffs, a second wind.

mods.name: Run HUD
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: A small panel with the numbers of your run: time in the room and in the game, kills, deaths, damage per second, damage dealt and taken. Kept with each save, with a recap when the final boss falls.

mods.name: Solo Randomizer
mods.author: 4rtefakt
mods.description: Shuffles what the tower's chests hold, from a seed, with no server: a new game is always beatable (keys, medallions and gear are placed with the tower's logic). Share a seed to race the same layout.
